paragraphs.en: The administration called an antique document bizarre, then tried to conceal corruption behind decorative fabric. Mira used its legal framework to challenge the gross misuse of relief funds. The fabric covered a notice board where the old emergency powers had once been posted. Residents lifted it so Mira could read the document beside the new campaign promises. Its language was stiff, but its requirement was plain: temporary powers had to be reviewed. Mira asked a teacher to explain the clause in ordinary words. People who could not read the older script listened and challenged the explanation. The document would have little force if only an auditor could understand when it protected them.
paragraphs.zh: 行政部門稱古老文書荒謬，企圖以華美布幔掩蓋貪腐。米拉援引法律架構挑戰濫用救濟金的行為。 布幔遮著曾張貼緊急權限的公告板。居民掀開，讓米拉把舊文件與新競選承諾並讀。文字古板，要求卻明確：臨時權力必須複核。她請教師用日常語句解釋。不識舊字體的人也能聽、能質疑。若只有稽核員讀懂保護何時生效，文件的力量就很有限。

paragraphs.en: Hostility rose around the orchard, where an icon of the city's founder faced a new campaign poster. Citizens asked Mira to nominate a candidate, but she refused to become another unchallenged ruler. The crowd began calling Mira's name as though that settled the question of leadership. She asked who would check her decisions if she accepted an unchecked office. A mechanic answered from beside the founder's statue: the same residents who should check everyone else's. Mira invited the gathering to nominate several people and question them publicly. The mechanic looked alarmed when someone suggested her. That hesitation made the choice more real than the chant had been. A candidate would have to explain the work, not simply accept admiration.
paragraphs.zh: 果園旁敵意升高，建城者雕像面對新的競選海報。市民要米拉提名人選，她拒絕成為另一個不容質疑的統治者。 人群喊著米拉名字，彷彿領導問題已決定。她問，若接受不受制衡職位，誰檢查她？雕像旁技師答，同樣該檢查所有官員的居民。米拉邀大家提名多人並公開問話。有人提技師時，她吃了一驚。猶豫使選擇比口號更真實：候選人得解釋工作，不能只接受崇拜。

paragraphs.en: The rally might prevail if rival neighborhoods trusted one another. A hidden subsidy had paid agitators to turn their excitement and thrill into fear. An argument broke out between two groups near the orchard gate. Ruth asked them to name the claim they disputed before repeating accusations about one another. The claim came from identical leaflets handed out on opposite sides of town. Nell collected examples with the recipients' permission and compared their printing marks. They did not prove who had paid for every leaflet. They did show that supposedly separate neighborhood complaints had been prepared together. The crowd could question the message without turning on the neighbors who had received it.
paragraphs.zh: 只要敵對街區願意互信，集會便可能獲勝。有人暗中補助煽動者，將民眾的興奮轉成恐懼。 果園門邊兩群人爭吵。露絲請他們先說具體爭議，別再互相指控。說法出自城兩端發的相同傳單。奈兒徵得收件者同意收樣，比對印刷記號。這不能證明每張由誰出錢，卻顯示貌似各區獨立的抱怨是一起製作的。人群可以質疑訊息，不必攻擊收到訊息的鄰居。

paragraphs.en: The city could not charge tuition for speaking freely, Mira said. She would not undermine a neighbor to win; the venture mattered only if no one was left without a voice. The teacher proposed reading each candidate's answers twice, once before the vote and again after the pledge was written. That would make an omission easier to notice. A market porter asked who would keep the copies if the office refused them. Three observers from different streets volunteered. Mira gave them the same information rather than a private version for favored allies. By the time ballots were prepared, the gathering had begun practicing the checks it wanted its future representatives to accept.
paragraphs.zh: 米拉說，城市不能向自由發言收學費。她不會為勝選抹黑鄰居；只有人人都能發聲，這場行動才有價值。 教師提議候選人答案讀兩次，投票前一次，承諾寫成後再一次，讓遺漏容易發現。市場搬運工問，若辦公室拒收，誰保管副本？三條街的觀察員自願。米拉提供相同資訊，不給親近盟友私人版本。選票備好時，集會已在練習希望未來代表接受的監督。

paragraphs.en: At the orchard rally, residents chose three candidates instead of elevating Mira herself. One was a teacher, one a mechanic, and one a market porter. They signed a public pledge requiring every emergency order to carry a review date. Voss's agents tried to interrupt the vote, but the ballots had already been copied by independent observers. For the first time, Mira was not the only person who knew how to oppose him. That gave her room to prepare for the next storm.
paragraphs.zh: 果園集會上，居民選出三名候選人，而非擁戴米拉：教師、技師與市場搬運工。三人簽下公開承諾，所有緊急命令都必須有複核日期。沃斯的人想打斷投票，選票早由獨立觀察員複製。米拉第一次發現，反對他的人不再只有自己，她終於能騰出手準備下一場風暴。

本段對照：果園集會上，居民選出三名候選人，而非擁戴米拉：教師、技師與市場搬運工。三人簽下公開承諾，所有緊急命令都必須有複核日期。沃斯的人想打斷投票，選票早由獨立觀察員複製。米拉第一次發現，反對他的人不再只有自己，她終於能騰出手準備下一場風暴。

paragraphs.en: Mira refused to attribute the malfunction to the workers. On their behalf, Dai showed a compact design, proven competence and a plan to coordinate the network's debut. Dai placed the school notebook beside the working diagram. The copied sequence was useful, but he would not ask a crew to trust an old classroom page without checking present equipment. Iona named each valve and another worker repeated its location. The exercise revealed places where a familiar nickname differed from the label on the wall. They wrote both names on the test sheet. During an alarm, a command could fail even when everyone understood the machinery if they did not understand one another.
paragraphs.zh: 米拉拒絕把故障怪罪工人。戴工程師代表大家展示緊湊設計、專業能力與首度啟用的協調計畫。 戴把學校筆記放在工作圖旁。抄出的順序有用，但未核對現有設備前，不能叫工班盲信舊教材。艾歐娜逐一說閥名，另一工人重述位置。他們發現俗名與牆上標示有別，便兩者都寫進測試表。警報時，即使人人懂機械，彼此用詞不通也會失敗。

paragraphs.en: The crew spoke of destiny, but the station was a practical domain where every donation had to be accounted for. Iona would execute the test only when all workers stood clear. The first test moved only a small amount of water while observers watched the adjoining gauges. Iona kept one hand away from the lever until the last worker answered. The delay made the visitors restless. Dai explained that the waiting was part of the design, because a test without a way to stop was simply another dangerous order. Mira noted the cost of the materials next to the donated parts. Shared labor deserved a clear account as much as money paid to a contractor.
paragraphs.zh: 團隊談著命運，但機房是務實的工作領域，每筆捐款都得交代清楚。艾歐娜只在全員退到安全區後才進行測試。 首次測試只放少量水，觀察員看相鄰壓力計。最後一人回報前，艾歐娜不碰拉桿。訪客等得焦躁，戴解釋等待是設計一部分：無法停止的測試只是另一道危險命令。米拉把材料費與捐贈零件並列；共同勞力同樣值得清楚記帳。

paragraphs.en: An immune child watched a strange insect migration from the window while a muscular opponent threatened to cut power. Mira insisted on checking the output before any public announcement. The threatened power cut forced a practical question that no speech could answer: which functions would survive without the master board? Dai asked the crew to identify them on the diagram before touching a switch. A worker pointed to a blank corner where an older feed ought to have been. Mira asked for a physical inspection rather than a guess. Outside the window, the child followed the insects with a finger, unaware that the adults were trying to find their own route through a changing system.
paragraphs.zh: 一名免疫力強的孩子從窗口看昆蟲遷徙，健壯的反對者卻威脅切電。米拉堅持先驗證輸出結果再向公眾公布。 切電威脅帶來演說回答不了的問題：主控制盤失效後哪些功能仍在？戴請工班先在圖上指出，再碰開關。工人指向應有舊供應線的空角落。米拉要求實地查看，不靠猜測。窗邊孩子用手指跟著昆蟲，不知道成人也在變動系統中找自己的路。

paragraphs.en: When the alarms sounded, crews had to scramble across a spectacular hall. A soaked sponge fell onto a cracked tile near a vendor's cart, revealing an old access hatch. The sponge had soaked up water seeping around a tile, making the outline of the hatch easier to see. Iona stopped the nearby work and checked whether the space below was safe to open. The vendor moved the cart away without being asked to abandon it. Dai compared the hatch's position with the missing corner on the drawing. They had not discovered a solution merely by finding a door, but they now had a place where the unexplained line might continue beyond the official plan.
paragraphs.zh: 警報響起時，工人衝過壯觀廳堂。濕海綿掉在攤販推車旁的裂磚上，露出老舊維修入口。 海綿吸起磚緣滲水，使入口輪廓更清楚。艾歐娜叫附近工人停下，先查下方能否安全開啟。攤販移開推車，不必被迫棄置。戴把入口位置對上圖中空角。找到門不等於找到答案，但未解線路可能在官方圖外繼續的地方，終於可查。

paragraphs.en: The old access hatch opened onto a second control room. Its walls held physical switches that could isolate each neighborhood from the central network without cutting its water supply. Dai demonstrated one switch, and the eastern clinic lights stayed on when the master board shut down. It was proof the city possessed another design. Mira ordered the procedure written in plain language and distributed before the company realized they had found it.
paragraphs.zh: 老維修口通往第二控制室，牆上有實體開關，能切斷中央網路對各社區的控制，卻不影響供水。戴試動一個開關，主控制盤關閉時，東診所燈仍亮著。城市確實擁有另一種設計。米拉要求用白話寫下程序，在公司察覺前送到各區。

paragraphs.en: Every complication exposed another constraint as a deadly surge approached. Voss offered an elaborate evacuation speech, but steam began to erupt from the lower chamber. Steam obscured the lower stair before the announcement on the television had finished. Mira sent a runner to check the upper exit instead of letting the speech determine the evacuation route. The runner returned with a report of rising water, and Suri marked it beside the latest street messages. The reports were imperfect, arriving at different times, but they named actual places. Mira asked for the oldest entries to be checked again so a route that had been safe half an hour earlier was not offered as safe now.
paragraphs.zh: 致命洪流逼近，每項併發問題都暴露新的限制。沃斯發表精巧的撤離演說，下層機房卻噴出蒸汽。 電視演說還沒完，蒸汽已遮住下樓梯。米拉派人查上方出口，不讓演說決定撤離路線。跑腿者回報漲水，蘇芮把它記在最新街報旁。消息時間不一、並不完美，卻指向真實地點。米拉要求重查最舊條目，免得把半小時前安全的路線當成現在仍安全。

paragraphs.en: A metal fragment struck the graphic display, ruining the official interpretation. Mira demanded intervention based on actual street reports rather than mainstream television claims. With the display dark, the console looked suddenly less authoritative. Dai used the paper network plan and asked each district to report its local gauge. Mira repeated the readings back before they were entered. A misplaced number could direct water toward the wrong street. Iona kept the local sequence visible beneath a lamp while another worker watched the lower door. They had practiced the words for the switches in daylight. Now, in the noise, the shared names made it possible to understand short instructions without guessing.
paragraphs.zh: 金屬碎片擊碎圖形顯示器，官方解釋再也站不住腳。米拉要求根據街道實況介入，而不是信奉主流電視說詞。 螢幕暗下，控制台忽然不再那麼威嚴。戴改用紙圖，請各區回報壓力計。米拉先複述再登記，錯置數字可能把水導往錯街。艾歐娜把區域順序放燈下，另一工人守下層門。白天練過的開關用語，此刻讓人能在噪音中理解短令，不必猜。

paragraphs.en: An engineer qualified to measure radiation calculated the ratio of safe pumps to failing pumps. Voss worried about lost revenue; a senator begged Mira not to tempt an armed response. The engineer marked an unusable pump with a broad cross rather than leaving a doubtful value in the total. Voss objected that stopping machinery would destroy the accounts. Mira asked which account could pay for a district flooded by a pump known to fail. The senator lowered his voice, but the water did not pause for the argument. Dai requested authority for local crews to halt independently. Mira understood the cost of dividing control and the greater danger of making every crew wait for her permission. He had needed specialist training to qualify for the radiation measurements, and he stated that limit before advising on the pumps.
paragraphs.zh: 合格工程師測量輻射，計算安全與故障水泵比例。沃斯只在乎收入，參議員則求米拉不要誘發武裝對抗。 工程師把不能用的水泵打大叉，不在總數中留下可疑值。沃斯說停機會毀帳，米拉問哪份帳能賠償明知故障還用泵而淹掉的街區。參議員壓低聲音，水卻不等爭論。戴要求區域工班有獨立停工權。米拉懂分散控制的代價，也懂讓人人等她許可更危險。 他曾受專業訓練，才具備測量輻射的資格；在提供水泵建議前，他先說明自己的專業界限。

paragraphs.en: The disaster began to unfold on an unprecedented scale. A vacuum seal broke, and even the youngest warrior in Mira's rescue team understood that saving strangers came before arresting enemies. A rescue volunteer saw someone trapped near the service doorway wearing a board employee's coat. Another volunteer recognized the badge and hesitated. Mira pointed toward the clear landing, not toward an arrest position. They brought the person out before deciding what questions should follow. Iona called from the switches that the channel was nearly ready. The separation of duties could no longer remain a suggestion on a sheet. Each coordinator needed enough authority to act while Mira stayed where the district calls could reach her.
paragraphs.zh: 災難以前所未有的規模展開，真空密封破裂。米拉救援隊最年輕的戰士也明白，救陌生人比逮捕敵人更急迫。 救援志工看見維修門邊有人受困，穿董事會員工外套。另一人認出徽章，猶豫了。米拉指向安全平台，而非逮捕位置。人先救出，問題之後再問。艾歐娜從開關處喊通道將就緒。紙上分工不能再只是建議；米拉守在能接各區回報的地方，各協調員必須有足夠權限自行行動。

paragraphs.en: When the central board failed, Mira did not order everyone into the dangerous tunnel. She put Yara in charge of shelters, Suri over routes, and Dai over the valves; each had authority to stop a procedure that endangered her team. At midnight Iona pulled the final local switch. Water roared through the empty service channel instead of the crowded East Ward. Mira heard people cheering above her, but she stayed at the console until every district answered the safety call.
paragraphs.zh: 中央控制盤失效時，米拉沒命所有人擠進危險隧道。她讓雅拉管收容、蘇芮管路線、戴管閥門，每人都有權停止危害團隊的程序。午夜，艾歐娜拉下最後一道區域開關。洪流奔入無人的維修道，而非擁擠東區。上方有人歡呼，米拉仍守在控制台直到每區回報平安。

paragraphs.en: Mira showed affection without promises she could not keep. She built an alliance and asked the court to authorize access to the barren site of an old burial ground. The night surge had left the burial ground wet but reachable. Mira did not let the urgency of discovery replace the court's permission. Families waited outside the marked area while the request was read aloud. Some wanted every surface opened immediately; others feared losing the last traces that might identify someone. Yara arranged a place where either group could step away from the work. Recovering a record was not the same as being ready to confront what that record might say about a missing relative.
paragraphs.zh: 米拉以真誠關懷代替空話。她組成聯盟，請法院授權調查荒蕪的舊墓地。 午夜洪流後，墓地仍濕，已可到達。米拉不讓發現急迫性取代法院授權。家屬在標示區外聽人朗讀申請，有人想立刻挖開一切，有人怕最後身分線索遭毀。雅拉安排可暫離工作的地方。找回紀錄，不等於已準備好面對它對失蹤親人可能說出的事。

paragraphs.en: The neighborhood once held a carnival, but rationed consumption had emptied its stalls. A wrongly convicted carpenter offered to donate tools in memory of his eternal friend. The carpenter offered tools, then asked to keep the smallest one beside him until he understood the work. Mira agreed. His earlier conviction had taught him how quickly an object could be turned into an accusation. Iona explained which tools would touch the lock and which should stay away from fragile paper. Ruth listed every borrowed item with its owner. People were contributing what they still possessed to recover a neighborhood that official records insisted had never possessed them at all. The decision to convict him had not made the missing neighborhood any less real.
paragraphs.zh: 社區過去舉辦嘉年華，物資配給卻使攤位空蕩。一名遭冤判的木匠願捐工具紀念已逝摯友。 木匠獻工具後，要求先留最小一件，等懂用途再交。米拉同意，他過去遭判刑的經驗使他知道物件多快能變成指控。艾歐娜解釋哪些可碰鎖、哪些須遠離脆紙。露絲記下每件借物與物主。人們拿剩下的財物，來找回官方紀錄聲稱從不曾擁有他們的街區。 對他作出的有罪判決，並沒有讓失落街區變得比較不真實。

paragraphs.en: A cracked jug beside a jar of mustard concealed part of the lock mechanism. Iona studied how to make it operational so that the original street signs could rise from the silt. Iona brushed the mechanism without turning it until Dai checked the connected channel. The jars and broken household objects had made the place look like abandoned storage. Beneath them lay fittings shaped for deliberate operation. A resident recognized the sound when the first part moved. It reminded her of the lock opening on market mornings. Mira asked that the memory be recorded separately from the mechanism's technical description. Both mattered, but one could not substitute for a safe inspection of the other. After the inspection, she operated the lock and watched the signs rise clear of the mud.
paragraphs.zh: 破水壺與芥末罐旁藏著水鎖機關的一部分。艾歐娜研究如何恢復機關功能，讓原本的街牌能從泥中升起。 戴查連接水道前，艾歐娜只清刷不轉機關。罐子和碎家用品使那裡像廢棄倉庫，底下卻是為操作而做的零件。第一部件動時，一位居民認出聲音，想起市場早晨開鎖。米拉請另記回憶，不與技術描述混寫。兩者重要，但記憶不能代替機械安全檢查。 檢查完成後，她操作水鎖，看著街牌從淤泥中升起。

paragraphs.en: Voss tried to proclaim victory through propaganda and a security squad. Mira answered with records of stability and interrupted transmission, refusing to accept his vague account. Voss's broadcast described the recovered area as a successful company clearance. Nell placed the interrupted messages beside the times the local crews had acted. His account omitted those crews entirely. Mira asked the temporary counters to display the sequence without adding praise for her. Residents arriving for corrections needed to know which documents had survived and where to appeal if a claim was refused. The company's version could be challenged with a public timeline; the people's names needed a process that would last beyond that argument.
paragraphs.zh: 沃斯派保全小隊，用宣傳宣告勝利。米拉提出穩定性與中斷傳輸紀錄，不接受他的模糊說法。 沃斯廣播把復原地區說成公司成功清理成果。奈兒把中斷訊息與區域工班行動時間並排，他的版本全漏了工班。米拉請臨時櫃台展示順序，不加對自己的讚美。前來更正的人需要知道何種文件尚存、被拒可去哪申訴。公開時間線能反駁公司，姓名卻需要比爭論更長久的程序。

paragraphs.en: The recovered street signs gave residents a place to begin reclaiming their names. A woman who had been listed as dead found the title to her bakery; a boy recognized the address written by his grandmother. Mira set up temporary counters staffed by volunteers and lawyers who could correct the record without charging fees. Then she stood aside and let the people speak for themselves. No leader could return all the lost years, but the city could stop pretending those years had never belonged to anyone.

paragraphs.en: The commission promised to assess the damage, not merely count each coffin. Judge Eun asked citizens to conceive a future after years of decline and to envision something beyond punishment. Eun began by explaining what the commission could decide and what would require another court. Several families had expected a final sentence that morning. Their disappointment was visible, and she did not ask them to hide it. Mira brought the recovered registry entries with the earlier refusals attached. A corrected name alone would not show how long a person had been denied help. The two records together could preserve both the restoration and the injury, without pretending the second had vanished because the first was finally possible.
paragraphs.zh: 委員會承諾評估損失，不只是數每一口棺木。恩法官請市民思考多年衰退後的未來，想像超越懲罰的道路。 恩先解釋委員會能決定哪些事、哪些得交別的法院。家屬原盼今早就有終判，她沒要求掩飾失望。米拉把找回戶籍與過去拒絕書一同送來。更正姓名本身看不出被拒援助多久；兩種紀錄合存，才能既保留復原也保留傷害，不因終於可更正就假裝傷害消失。

paragraphs.en: The judicial hearing marked a milestone. Voss tried to mock witnesses while a laboratory expert traced a missing nutrient to a particle found in the drinking water. The laboratory expert was asked to explain the limits of the water sample before describing the particle. Voss laughed at the admission that not every past condition could be reconstructed. Eun stopped him and repeated the expert's distinction. Uncertainty about one measurement did not erase a documented order or payment. Yara listened from the witness seats, relieved that the hearing did not require her to claim knowledge she lacked. Mira marked the technical findings separately from the administrative decisions they might help explain.
paragraphs.zh: 司法聽證會成為里程碑。沃斯嘲弄證人，實驗室專家則追查飲用水微粒裡缺少的養分。 實驗室專家先說水樣限制，再描述微粒。沃斯笑他承認無法重建全部舊狀況，恩制止並重述區別：一項測量不確定，不會抹掉有紀錄的命令與付款。證人席的雅拉慶幸不必假裝知道自己不知道的事。米拉把技術結果與可能由此解釋的行政決定分列。

paragraphs.en: A pension ledger showed how productivity bonuses had concealed a profound theft. Two sibling witnesses appeared, one speaking alone about the stereotype that poor families always lied. The siblings disagreed over the date of a pension visit. Their lawyer tried to settle it quickly, but Eun allowed each to explain. One remembered the office appointment; the other remembered the later refusal at home. The disagreement had concealed two events rather than destroyed either account. Mira found the corresponding entries on separate ledger pages. A process designed only to catch contradiction could have silenced them. Here, a patient question made the pension trail more precise and gave both witnesses room to remain truthful. One had requested a solo appearance before the two accounts were compared.
paragraphs.zh: 退休金帳簿顯示生產力獎金如何掩護重大竊案。兩名手足出庭，其中一人單獨打破「窮人必說謊」的刻板印象。 手足對退休金訪查日期說法不同。律師想迅速解決，恩讓兩人各自解釋。一人記得辦公室預約，另一人記得後來到家拒絕。分歧藏著兩件事，未必推翻任何一方。米拉在不同帳頁找到對應。若程序只求抓矛盾，兩人可能被迫沉默；耐心追問讓金流更精確，也使證人有空間說真話。 其中一人要求先單獨出庭，再比較兩人的敘述。

paragraphs.en: In a subsequent hearing, Mira refused to thrust blame onto junior clerks. The city needed a treaty of responsibilities, not another list of convenient scapegoats. Mira described how orders passed through offices and where a clerk could reasonably have stopped them. She refused to give every signature the same weight. Some people had created the harmful policy; others had copied a form under threat; still others had tried to object. Eun asked her to identify evidence for each distinction. Mira removed one unverified claim from her statement. The commission would be stronger for recording that limit than for presenting an accusation so complete that no uncertainty was allowed to remain.
paragraphs.zh: 後續聽證中，米拉不把罪責推給低階職員。城市需要權責協議，而不是另一份方便的代罪羔羊名單。 米拉描述命令如何流經辦公室、職員何處有能力阻止，不讓每個簽名負相同責任。有人制定傷害政策，有人受威脅抄表，有人曾反對。恩要求逐項證據，米拉從陳述刪掉一項未核實主張。承認界限，比呈現一份不容任何疑問的完整指控，更能使委員會可靠。

paragraphs.en: The commission's final interim report named the officials who had approved the secret gate and the companies that had profited. It also recorded public agencies that had tried to help but lacked the authority to intervene. Judge Eun said the distinction mattered: a truthful history could not be built from heroes and villains alone. Mira signed only the sections she had personally verified. The complete report was placed in three public libraries, beyond the reach of any one minister's drawer.
paragraphs.zh: 委員會期中報告列出批准祕密水閘的官員與獲利公司，也記錄那些曾想幫忙卻無權介入的公共機構。恩法官說區分很重要，真實歷史不能只由英雄與惡人構成。米拉只簽署親自核實的部分。完整報告分存三座公共圖書館，不再落入任何部長的抽屜。

paragraphs.en: Bea measured carbon in the smog and watched a chubby child carry his books. Every contractor had to conform to an ecological standard rather than dismiss public discourse as noise. Bea put the air readings beside the proposed construction timetable. Work could improve the water system while making the streets harder to breathe in. A contractor wanted the dust figures removed as a distraction. She asked him which days he intended children to use the road beside his site. The question moved the discussion from an abstract standard to a route people needed. Mira requested a revised timetable with the same work and a stated way to reduce exposure, rather than a promise that every inconvenience would disappear.
paragraphs.zh: 碧亞量測霧霾中的碳，望著圓潤孩子抱著書。承包商必須符合生態標準，不能把公開討論當作噪音。 碧亞把空氣讀數與施工表並排。修水網同時可能讓街道更難呼吸。包商要刪揚塵數字，說會分散注意，她問施工旁道路哪些日子要讓孩子走。問題把抽象標準變成真實路線。米拉要求同樣工程重排並說明減少暴露方法，不要保證一切不便消失。

paragraphs.en: Their equation was explicit: each system would inject only the required energy, and residents could modify the plan. Ada served pastry while an elderly patron studied the drawings. The patron asked where the energy estimate allowed for a pump used during an emergency. Dai showed a separate line and admitted that the first sketch had underestimated its duration. Ada brought another sheet rather than letting anyone write over the old figures. Residents could then see what the revision changed. Mira liked one feature of the slower meeting: an awkward question did not disappear into an office and return as an unexplained total. Its effect remained visible beside the pastry crumbs and the original drawing.
paragraphs.zh: 方程式說得明白：系統只能注入所需能源，居民可以修改方案。艾達端出糕點，老顧客細看圖紙。 老顧客問估算何處包含緊急水泵。戴指出另列的一行，承認初稿低估運行時間。艾達另拿紙，不讓人蓋寫舊數。居民能看見改了什麼。米拉喜歡慢會議的一點：難題不會消失進辦公室，再變成無解釋的總額；其影響就在糕點屑和原圖旁可見。

paragraphs.en: During rehearsal for a flood scenario, smog alarms startled the planners. Their sophisticated controls could not repair everything, and a crate of squash rolled across the floor. The rolling squash interrupted the rehearsal before the planners noticed that their evacuation path crossed a delivery route. Suri asked the delivery worker to move the empty crate along the line they had drawn. It blocked the turn exactly where a wheelchair would need room. No complex control could solve that physical obstruction. They moved the unloading point on the plan and ran the exercise again. The smog alarm remained a separate problem to address, not an excuse to abandon what the fallen vegetables had revealed.
paragraphs.zh: 洪災情境排演時，霧霾警報驚動規劃者。精密控制系統無法修好一切，一箱南瓜滾滿地板。 南瓜滾落打斷排演，規劃者才注意撤離路線跨過送貨線。蘇芮請工人沿圖推空箱，恰在輪椅需轉彎處卡住。精密控制解不了實體阻礙。他們改卸貨點，再演一次。霧霾警報仍須另處理，不是放棄蔬菜所揭問題的理由。

paragraphs.en: Mira asked citizens to submit designs despite the tangle of problems caused by unemployment. She let them whine about delays, because a city built with consent would endure better than one built in silence. A worker objected that the cheaper material would require repairs sooner. Another worried that rejecting it would leave her without wages this month. Mira asked the budget group to show both the immediate cost and the expected maintenance cost. She favored one proposal, but the neighborhood representatives preferred a different balance. Instead of extending the debate until they agreed with her, she asked them to state their reasons for the public vote. Rebuilding would mean accepting decisions she could inspect without necessarily controlling them.
paragraphs.zh: 米拉請市民提交設計，儘管失業造成一團糾結難題。她容許大家抱怨進度，因為經同意建成的城市比強迫沉默更堅固。 工人說便宜材料較快要修，另一人怕不用就失去本月工資。米拉請預算組同時列立即費用與預期維護費。她偏好一案，各區代表卻選另一種平衡。她不拖到大家同意自己，而請他們在公開投票前說明理由。重建意味她能檢查決定，卻未必控制決定。

paragraphs.en: The reconstruction vote took place in Ada's courtyard instead of a guarded mansion. Each neighborhood had its own representative, and the budget was projected on a sheet large enough for children to read. The winning plan preserved parks, used affordable materials and required a public test before any major pump was installed. Mira lost two arguments during the debate. She accepted the result, relieved that people were becoming skilled enough to disagree with her.
paragraphs.zh: 重建表決在艾達的校園舉行，而非戒備森嚴的豪宅。每區都有代表，預算投影在孩子也看得見的大布幕上。勝出的方案保留公園、採用可負擔材料，並要求大型水泵裝設前先公開測試。米拉在辯論中輸了兩項主張，但她接受結果，慶幸人們已有能力與她意見不同。

paragraphs.en: The parties met in accord that no family should suffer another year of agony. Behind windows that rain had begun to blur, Mira began to browse the evidence while a single piano chord echoed in the hall. The piano belonged to a waiting room, where someone had struck a key while moving a bench. Its unfinished sound followed Mira into the evidence room. She opened her notebook to the first chapel entry, then checked the dates against the court index. The work now occupied boxes instead of a single damp ledger. She still needed to distinguish the things she had seen herself from the things others had established. On the witness stand, her reputation could not replace a clear answer about how each fact reached her.
paragraphs.zh: 各方至少同意，不該再讓家庭承受一年的痛苦。雨水使窗面漸趨模糊，米拉在窗後開始瀏覽證據，廳中響起單一鋼琴和弦。 鋼琴在等候室，有人搬椅碰了琴鍵，未完的聲音跟米拉進證物室。她翻回聖堂初筆，拿日期核對法庭索引。工作已由一冊濕帳擴成箱箱文件，她仍須分清親眼所見與他人證實之事。證人席上，名聲不能取代每項事實如何到她手中的清楚回答。

paragraphs.en: Her argument was coherent: the confrontation concerned deliberate orders, not bad weather. The judges would descend into the archive to examine the doctrine used to justify execution of the plan. A judge asked why a floodgate order could not be treated as an unfortunate response to bad weather. Mira laid out the approval, the concealed maintenance account, and the later map alteration in order. Weather explained the water arriving; it did not explain those decisions being hidden. She stopped there rather than claiming the documents revealed every thought in Voss's mind. In the archive, the judges would be able to inspect the same sequence, including the gaps the investigation had not resolved.
paragraphs.zh: 她論點清晰：對質涉及蓄意命令，而非壞天氣。法官下到檔案庫，檢查用來正當化執行計畫的教條。 法官問為何不能把水閘命令視為天氣惡劣下的不幸應變。米拉按序列核准、隱匿維修帳、後續改圖。天氣解釋水為何來，不能解釋決定為何被藏。她就此停下，不說文件能揭沃斯每個念頭。法官在檔案庫可查同樣順序，包括調查仍未解的缺口。

paragraphs.en: An extensive index listed every nasty scheme. Outside, a riot threatened to begin when a guard tried to slap a protester; Mira ordered her supporters to soften their voices. The commotion outside reached the hall as a confused roar. Ruth went to the entrance with an observer, and Mira asked her supporters to leave room for people who wanted to depart. Someone demanded that the guard be seized immediately. She requested that the attempted assault be witnessed and reported, while the hearing continued inside. A confrontation at the door could swallow the testimony everyone had waited years to hear. The index remained open on the table, its numbered references quieter and more durable than the shouts.
paragraphs.zh: 詳盡索引列著每個惡劣陰謀。外頭警衛想掌摑抗議者，暴動一觸即發；米拉要支持者放低聲量。 外面喧鬧傳入成混亂吼聲。露絲與觀察員到入口，米拉請支持者留空間給要離開的人。有人要立刻抓警衛，她要求見證並通報企圖攻擊，同時繼續聽證。門口衝突可能吞掉大家等多年的證詞。桌上索引仍攤開，編號參照比叫喊安靜，也更持久。

paragraphs.en: Lawyers could speculate about motive, but a spouse had signed as witness to the forged approval. Mira asked only for a worthy ruling that would protect people who had never held power. The spouse was asked to identify the signature without being made responsible for every act of the person married to them. Mira welcomed that distinction. She had followed family connections when they led to records, but had refused to treat kinship as a substitute for evidence. Now the court had an actual witness to the approval process. Before judgment, she reviewed the requested remedies with the families' lawyers. Removal from office would matter, but so would the practical means to recover money and challenge future emergency orders.
paragraphs.zh: 律師可以揣測動機，但有人的配偶曾簽名見證偽造核准。米拉只要求一項值得信任、能保障無權者的判決。 法庭請配偶辨認簽名，沒有要其為婚姻對象所有行為負責。米拉認同這區別。她曾循親屬關係找紀錄，卻不以血親代替證據。現在核准程序有真正證人。判決前，她和家屬律師重看救濟要求。免職重要，追回款項與質疑未來緊急命令的實際方法也重要。

paragraphs.en: The court ruled that Voss had knowingly concealed the emergency gate and diverted public money. He was removed from office and ordered to face further proceedings over the missing workers. The judgment did not erase every injury, and several families left the hall in silence. Mira refused the reporters' request for a triumphant pose. She read the ruling once more, checking the provisions for restitution and independent oversight. Then she returned to the city square, where a public charter still needed its final signatures.
paragraphs.zh: 法院認定沃斯明知祕密水閘存在，仍刻意隱瞞並挪用公款。他被免職，還須為失蹤工人接受後續審理。判決無法抹平所有傷害，有些家庭沉默離開。米拉拒絕記者要她做勝利姿勢的要求，而是重新讀判決，確認賠償與獨立監督條款。之後她返回廣場，公共憲章仍等著最後簽署。

title: The City No One Can Own

paragraphs.en: Standing alongside children, Mira opened an alternate route beside the restored canal. The word communism appeared in a hostile leaflet, but she insisted that the crucial question was who could inspect the records. A child stopped at the canal notice and asked whether the new path could close during another emergency. Mira pointed to the place where a closure would have to be recorded with its reason and review date. The answer was less exciting than declaring that nothing bad could happen again. It was also something the child could check later. A resident carrying the hostile leaflet joined them. Mira offered the same explanation, leaving the person free to criticize the charter after reading its actual provisions.
paragraphs.zh: 米拉與孩子並肩站著，開啟修復運河旁的替代道路。敵意傳單寫著共產主義，她堅持真正關鍵是誰能檢查紀錄。 孩子在運河公告前問，再有緊急狀況，新路會不會關。米拉指給他看，關閉必須記理由與複核日期。答案沒有「壞事永不再來」動聽，卻能日後查證。持敵意傳單的居民走近，她同樣解釋，讓對方讀真條文後仍可批評憲章。

paragraphs.en: The city would evolve beyond one leader's grip. Her hypothesis was simple: optimism meant work, and originality meant refusing the old machine's false choices. The new board's table had no chair reserved permanently for her. Mira found the empty space unsettling before she found it welcome. For months, every unanswered question had seemed to arrive in her notebook. Now a clerk directed one question to a neighborhood representative and another to the inspection group. Neither looked at Mira for permission. She wrote down the date, recognizing a change that would not appear in a heroic portrait: useful work was proceeding in her presence without requiring her command.
paragraphs.zh: 城市要走出單一領袖的掌握。她的假設很簡單：樂觀必須付諸行動，原創就是拒絕舊機器設下的假選擇。 新董事會桌邊沒有永久留給她的椅子。米拉先覺不安，才覺歡迎。幾個月來，未答問題似乎全進她筆記。如今職員把一題交各區代表，另一題交檢查組，無人看她求許可。她記下日期，看見英雄肖像畫不出的改變：有用的工作在她面前進行，無需她下令。

paragraphs.en: A poetic speech from a street prophet followed the steady pulse of drums. When the council set a fair water quota, families recognized a resemblance to the promises they had once made themselves. The quota debate lasted longer than the celebration speeches. A household caring for sick relatives needed more water than the proposed allowance. Another feared that exceptions would reopen the old private privileges. Yara helped the board frame a public appeal process with reasons that could be reviewed without exposing medical details. Mira listened from the ordinary seats. The first version of fairness had been too simple. Being able to revise it openly was a better sign than pretending the celebration had already answered every difficult need.
paragraphs.zh: 街頭先知用詩般演說應和穩定鼓聲。議會訂下公平用水配額時，家庭認出它與當年彼此的承諾相似。 配額辯論比慶祝演說久。照顧病親家庭需較多水，有人怕例外重開特權。雅拉幫董事會設公開申訴程序，使理由可複核又不洩病情。米拉坐一般席聽。第一版公平過於簡單，能公開修正，比假裝慶祝已回答所有難題更好。

paragraphs.en: No shareholder could make the water price soar without review. The charter would specify every stimulus payment, and its most striking sentence declared that Mira herself could be removed by a public vote. Before signing, Mira asked a student to read the removal clause aloud. The student stumbled over one legal phrase, and the drafters agreed to replace it with ordinary words. No one should need her help to discover how to challenge her. The signatures filled the sheet slowly, with space left for objections to be recorded beside them. She put the pen down and walked past the canal without an escort. The next months would test the machinery and the charter alike, through work that belonged to the city rather than to her. A resident asked how to appeal if a relief voucher was refused. The drafters pointed to the same review process, rather than sending her to seek a private favor from a board member.
paragraphs.zh: 沒有股東能不經審查就任意調漲水價。憲章列明每筆刺激補助，最醒目的一句是：連米拉本人，也可以透過公開投票被撤換。 簽前，米拉請學生朗讀撤換條款。他卡在一處法律用語，起草者同意改成日常話。人們不該要她幫忙才知道如何質疑她。簽名慢慢填上，旁邊留記反對意見的空間。她放筆，無隨從走過運河。未來幾月，機械與憲章都要受檢驗；工作屬於城市，不屬她。 一位居民問救濟券若被拒收如何申訴。起草者指出相同複核程序，而非叫她私下求董事幫忙。

paragraphs.en: Six months later, the water gates had been tested in public three times. The city board now published its accounts and allowed residents to challenge any emergency order. Mira had declined a permanent executive seat. She taught a free evening class on reading contracts and kept her old notebook on a shelf where students could examine it. On the first page she wrote a final sentence: “A strong city does not need one woman who cannot be defeated. It needs people who no longer have to kneel.”
paragraphs.zh: 六個月後，水閘已公開測試三次。新的市民董事會公布帳目，居民也可質疑任何緊急命令。米拉婉拒永久行政席位，改教免費夜課，教大家讀合約，舊筆記本放在學生可查閱的架上。扉頁她寫下最後一句：「堅強的城市不需要一名永不敗的女人，需要的是再也不必下跪的人們。」
